fact: A 2022 University of Namibia honours study of police stations in the Omusati region (8 officers interviewed of 15 sampled, from a population of 65) found that officers record by hand, first in the station crime register and then in paper files kept in cabinets or boxes, and concluded that no digital record system is in place there; its subject is traffic offence records, though its questions were put about crime records generally.

The 2022 Omusati study states that its assumption that the police had embarked on digital crime records proved incorrect and that no digital record system is in place; one officer said that at present most stations have no reliable electricity and no computers, and officers at rural police posts said electricity could be many years away.
